name: Matrix Channel
description: Matrix Client-Server API channel adapter - per-agent homeserver accounts, /sync long poll, m.room.message send/receive

configSchema.description: Base URL of the Matrix homeserver, e.g. https://matrix.example.com. Shared by every configured agent account unless the agent overrides it.
Fully-qualified Matrix user ID for this agent's account, e.g. @farnsworth:example.com.
Matrix access token for this agent's account. Obtained from a login call or the homeserver admin API.
BotNexus agent ID that messages arriving on this Matrix account route to.
Whether the account automatically accepts room invites observed on /sync.
Long-poll timeout in milliseconds passed to the Matrix /sync endpoint.
Minimum interval in milliseconds between streaming edit (m.replace) updates for a single in-flight response.
